title: Briefing for 2026-10-04
intro: Good morning. Here is your briefing for 2026-10-04: US markets, global news, and the Philippines, in five minutes.
us: Men are losing ground in the labor market. Here's why. Labor market faltered in September as jobs increased by just 29,000, unemployment rate rose to 4.2%. The September jobs report will be released Friday. Here's what to expect. Fed’s preferred gauge showed core inflation at 3.0% in August, much lighter than expected. The Fed's main inflation measure will be released Wednesday. Here's what to expect. America's Canadian import restrictions come into force. Here are the products barred from entry.
global: Cornell president says university 'must do better' after frat house rape allegations. Flydubai co-pilot attacked captain with axe, UAE official says. 'Anger in the streets': Tens of thousands protest in Spain over housing crisis. G7 to release millions of barrels of oil and diesel after Trump threat. Medical plane with 6 on board missing off Massachusetts coast. Why has Brazil accused the US of election interference?.
philippines: Olafur Eliasson’s ‘Your Curious Journey’ helped me bring the little things back in focus. Ayuda to roads: Where the House wants to add billions in the 2027 budget. In southern Philippines, Tawi-Tawi builds feasts to be shared. Pete Lacaba for National Artist. My mother would have approved..
outro: That's your briefing. Have a great day.
